description: Maps OCR line-item `label` text to SBS Field Name (primary_sbs_label). Use alias_index for O(1) lookup on anchors_lib.normalize(label); fall back to anchor_match() for fuzzy hits. alias_conflicts require page context (asset vs liability, current vs non-current) to resolve.
normalization: alias_index/alias_conflicts keys are anchors_lib.normalize() output: NFKD accent strip, lowercase, drop '(Nota..)', strip leading +/-/=, drop punctuation, collapse whitespace.
